dsDescriptionValue.value: Simulation data for Large-Scale Simulation Study of Active Learning models for Systematic Reviews. In this repository, 27001 active learning simulations are contained. 13 models for the 26 datasets found in the SYNERGY dataset. The study is currently in review.
